Hazardous waste segregation and labeling controls
Surface deformation identified during final inspection
Visual and dimensional deviation detected before release. Affected output was segregated.
Place affected items on hold and initiate technical investigation.
Cleaning and passivation result outside acceptance criteria
Process record indicated inconsistent finishing result requiring rework and parameter review.
Load shifted during internal handling without injury.
Area secured; handling equipment and method reviewed before restarting activity.
Waste container was identified with mixed waste that required controlled segregation.
Container quarantined, contents reclassified and disposal route verified.
Controlled document used after review date
A sampled work instruction remained in use with periodic review overdue.
Stabilize finishing process and strengthen final verification
Corrective action initiated following repeated variation in finishing results.
Increase final verification and segregate affected output.
Process parameters and verification criteria were not consistently controlled across shifts.
Standardize process parameters, revise instruction and verify operator competence.
Improve load-handling planning and pre-use verification
Corrective action following an OH&S near miss.
Suspend the specific handling method pending review.
Handling plan did not sufficiently address load geometry and stability.
Introduce lift-plan criteria and competency verification for non-routine loads.
Ensure reviews are scheduled, evidenced and escalated before expiration.
Configure reminders, overdue escalation and review evidence in Document Control.
No active controlled document remains beyond its review date without an approved disposition.
Product arrived with visible transport damage
Customer reported visible damage after delivery and supplied supporting photographs.
Review packing evidence, dispatch photographs, handling records and transport conditions.
Required certificate was not included in the original document package.
Missing certificate issued and document-package checklist updated.
Revise controlled document review and escalation process
Update review workflow, approval evidence and escalation for overdue controlled information.
Improvement identified from audit and management review.
Document control workflow and related procedure require revision.
Document controllers require awareness of the updated workflow.
No unacceptable new risk expected; verify after implementation.
Integrated Management System Internal Audit – Cycle 2
Quality, environment and OH&S processes across selected operational and support activities.
ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, internal documented information and applicable compliance obligations.
Operational controls, worker safety and emergency preparedness.
IMS operational controls and OH&S requirements.
Sampled records did not consistently demonstrate completed review before due date.
One sampled temporary waste container did not display the required identification.
Opportunity to integrate pre-task risk review with work planning
Integrating risk review into work planning could improve consistency and evidence.
Good practice: visual segregation of inspection status
Clear visual status identification reduced the risk of unintended product release.
